title: Design a rate limiter that works across multiple servers.
description: Use a centralized store like Redis with sliding window or token bucket algorithms.

data.text: **Question:** Design a rate limiter that works across multiple servers.
Store counters in Redis using a sliding window or token bucket. All app servers read and write to the same Redis instance or cluster.

items: Algorithm: sliding window log, sliding window counter, or token bucket
Store: Redis with atomic INCR and EXPIRE
Response: 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After header
Granularity: per user, per API key, or per IP
Storing counters in memory (not shared across servers)
Using fixed windows that allow bursts at boundaries
How do you handle rate limiting in a distributed cache?
What is a token bucket algorithm?
How do you test rate limiters?
